**EON Calendar** — Events with repetition, exceptions, time zones and reminders, in day, week, month and agenda views, with iCalendar import and export, from EON Office.
Early (formats `v0`): for trying out.

**Install:** download the file for your platform and run it. That is all: EON Calendar
stands alone, and nothing else has to be installed or running. If you use EON Launcher, *Get
applications* (with previews on) does the same and checks the file against the index.

**Not signed** — EON has no signing keys yet (plan, madde 30 and 34). Check the files against
`SHA256SUMS.txt`. On Windows, Smart App Control (if on) refuses unsigned downloads.

No telemetry, no account. Your calendar stays on your device, in the EON Office folder of your
user profile.
